description: If you do not create a routine, you will be distracted and allow chaos to rule your world. #routine #selflove #leadershipskills #confidence
transcript: One of the most important things that you can do for yourself is create a routine. When you have a routine, it is easier to see distractions. When you are laxadacious and just allow the day to day to be the day to day, it is easier to waste your time. You allow chaos and distractions to take over your world, and you lose control.
